message.content: Buddhism was founded by **Siddhartha Gautama**, who became known as the **Buddha** (“the awakened one”). He lived in the 5th–4th centuries BCE in the region that is today part of **India and Nepal**. The Buddha was born in Lumbini (present‑day Nepal), attained enlightenment under the Bodhi tree in Bodh Gaya (present‑day Bihar, India), and taught his disciples there, establishing the core teachings that would spread throughout Asia.
